selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cup/mug and distinguish it from similar vessels like bowls or pitchers.
To verify the structural integrity of the handle-to-body connection, a common failure point in AI generation (floating or fused handles).
To ensure the liquid level sits correctly within the rim geometry without perspective distortion or bleeding.
To analyze the crackle glaze texture for natural consistency vs. AI-generated noise or smearing.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle's connection to the mug body; AI often fails to merge these seamlessly. Check if the 'crackle' texture on the ceramic looks like a coherent material property or random noise overlay. Verify that the ellipse of the rim matches the perspective of the base.
